payload.summary: Release browser matrix: three intermittent WebKit/Firefox failures still unexplained after the 2026-09-26 fixes
payload.detail: Seen once each on main release-browser-matrix runs 36180096691 and 36181326702, all passing locally (32/32 including repeats): (1) firefox ui-smoke 'document detail back arrow restores its originating search' - the Open link click completed but no navigation followed for 30s (trace shows prefetches only; possible dropped client navigation); (2) webkit ui-clinical-ask:85 '@critical keeps local-only Smart search within five catalogue modes' - smart-search-intent-cue never rendered; (3) webkit + mobile-pwa-standalone ui-overlap:613 'the one-line prompt rail offers a real control to reach its clipped chips' - the scroll control did not move the rail. Diagnostics artifacts are on those runs. The tools details-panel and guide-centre failures from the same runs are fixed by the tools overflow-x-clip change and the guide opening-frame wait.
